Definition: {Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity}
BiblicalUsage: Israel is named 7 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Ezra 5:1; Ezra 5:11; Ezra 6:14. In Ezra 5:1 we read, "Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo..." It appears again in Ezra 6:14: "And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the..."
TheologicalSignificance: Israel is part of the family history Scripture preserves, and I believe those lists are not filler. God kept the name, and that tells me he kept the person.
